wizard.title: Let's build your showcase
wizard.description: 3 questions, and your page exists — already filled in for your trade. Everything stays editable afterward.
wizard.businessNamePlaceholder: No name? Your first name works great.

errors.not_authenticated: You need to be logged in to create a showcase.
errors.project_limit_reached: Project limit reached for your plan.
errors.content_blocked: Hate speech or explicit content is forbidden and penalized on FLUX; please respect your environment and that of others. After 3 violations of our terms of use, the account is deleted.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.

pageEditor.heroText: Here, you create your signature: your name, your images, your colors, your proof and your world. Every section deserves your attention, because your showcase becomes your kingdom.
pageEditor.upToDate: Your live site is up to date
pageEditor.creatorText: Move forward room by room. Each block has its role: set your identity, show your know-how, reassure, then make people want to choose you.

identite.name: Name
identite.tagline: Your tagline (the one that sounds like you)
identite.taglinePlaceholder: E.g.: Your car looking new again, no endless appointments.

photos.trigger: My photos — logo, hero photo, gallery
photos.logo: Your logo or a photo of yourself
photos.hero: The big photo at the top of your page
photos.heroVideo: A welcome video (instead of the photo)
photos.videoHint: Short and with no sound, it plays at the top of your page. Your photo serves as the loading image.

prestations.empty: Add your products or bookings first. They'll be automatically checked here and visible on your showcase.

boutique.text: Your products (stock, revenue) and your promo offers are managed on their dedicated pages. They appear right away in your showcase preview.

contact.floatingCtaHint: A button always visible at the bottom of your page to message or call you.
contact.hours: Your displayed hours (optional, one line per day)

style.libraryText: Pick a matching kit or let FLUX start from your vibe.
style.autoKit: Let FLUX choose based on the vibe
style.colorHint: The primary color colors your buttons and prices. The dark one dresses the bottom of your page. Text adapts automatically to stay readable.
style.heroGradient: Gradient at the top of the page
style.heroGradientHint: Without a photo or video, the top blends your dark color with your primary color.
style.sameAsPage: Same as the rest of the page

pageEditor.sectionsAccordion: My page's sections — order and blocks

avis.text: Copy over the reviews you've already received (Google, Instagram, SMS). If you don't add any, the section won't appear.

offre.messagePlaceholder: E.g.: -20% on your first visit in January
offre.messageHint: Shown as a banner at the very top of your page. Optional.
offre.hint: With an end date, a countdown is displayed and the banner disappears automatically once it's over. The code copies in one click.

seo.googleTitlePlaceholder: E.g.: Barber in Lyon 3 — Chez Marco
seo.googleDescriptionPlaceholder: The sentence that makes people want to click in search results.
seo.shareImageHint: By default, your big photo at the top of the page is used.
seo.hideBrandingAllowed: Remove the signature at the bottom of your public page.
seo.hideBrandingRestricted: Feature reserved for the Enterprise plan at $89/month.
seo.hideBrandingAria: Hide the Wayne Web Flux signature

legal.trigger: Legal notices — already written for you
legal.text: Everything is already drafted. When you have 2 minutes, replace the [TO COMPLETE] with your info. Nothing is blocked without it.
legal.needsLocalReview: These texts are a starting point written for French law: in another language or country, they must be reviewed and adapted by a professional before being considered legally valid.

languages.text: Your store is published in {locale} by default. Activate an extra language to offer it translated to your visitors.
languages.deactivateConfirm: Deactivate this language? The translated content is kept and reappears if you reactivate it.
languages.activateCost: This language will be translated automatically for {cost} credits.
languages.insufficientCredits: Not enough credits to activate this language.

actionErrors.subpage_limit_reached: Page limit reached for your plan.
actionErrors.path_locked: The address of a published page can no longer be changed.
actionErrors.path_taken: This address is already in use.
actionErrors.content_blocked: Hate speech or explicit content is forbidden and penalized on FLUX; please respect your environment and that of others. After 3 violations of our terms of use, the account is deleted.
actionErrors.unknown: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
actionErrors.not_authenticated: You need to be logged in to continue.
actionErrors.too_many_sections: Too many sections on the page.
actionErrors.section_text_too_long: One of the section texts is too long.
actionErrors.too_many_faq_items: Too many questions in the FAQ.
actionErrors.invalid_google_business_link: The Google Business Profile link isn't valid.
actionErrors.nav_link_too_long: One of the menu links is too long.
actionErrors.branding_requires_enterprise: The signature can only be removed with the Enterprise plan at €89/month.
actionErrors.invalid_background_media_source: The background image or video must be uploaded from the editor.
actionErrors.invalid_poster_media_source: The poster image must be uploaded from the editor.
actionErrors.too_many_video_backgrounds: Only one video background per page (to keep your page fast).

pagesBar.pickerTitle: Which page do you want to add?
pagesBar.pickerHint: The page is pre-filled then fully editable. It stays in draft until you publish.

subpageEditor.heroText: Build this page with the same blocks as your homepage. It will go live at /p/{slug}/{path} on the next publish.
subpageEditor.upToDate: Your live site is up to date
subpageEditor.confirmDeleteLocked: This page will be removed from your site on the next publish. Continue?
subpageEditor.confirmDeleteDraft: Delete this draft page? This action is immediate.
subpageEditor.pendingDeletion: This page will be deleted on the next publish.
subpageEditor.addressLockedHint: The address of an already published page can no longer be changed (it may already be indexed).

texte.title: Title
texte.body: Text (skip a line for a new paragraph)

aPropos.title: Title
aPropos.titlePlaceholder: E.g.: Behind the scissors, that's me

carte.label: Address shown on Google Maps
carte.linked: The map stays automatically linked to the address entered in "Identity".
carte.needsAddress: Enter your address in "Identity" to activate this section.

googleBusiness.linkLabel: Link to your Google Business Profile listing
googleBusiness.linkHint: In Google Business Profile, choose "Ask for reviews" then paste the link here.
googleBusiness.messagePlaceholder: Check out our reviews or share your experience in a few seconds.

newsletter.textPlaceholder: Get my offers and news, no spam.

video.hint: YouTube, Vimeo, or a direct link to a video file.

sectionsPanel.hint: Drag sections to choose their order, hide the ones you don't want, and add your own blocks.
sectionsPanel.addPrompt: Which block do you want to add?
sectionsPanel.mapNeedsAddress: First enter your address in "Identity" to activate the map.

sectionStyle.videoHint: Only one background video per page, short and with no sound — prefer a photo to keep your page fast.
sectionStyle.overlayHint: Darkens the photo or video to keep text readable.

navigationPanel.title: Navigation menu
navigationPanel.description: A menu bar at the top of your site, with links to your pages and sections.
navigationPanel.stickyHint: The menu stays visible while scrolling.
navigationPanel.transparentHint: No background, sitting on top of your big photo.
navigationPanel.showLogoHint: Your logo (or your initial) on the left of the menu.
navigationPanel.scrollTopHint: A floating button appears after scrolling one screen.

publish.trialOverText: Your trial has ended and you have no credits left. Your site stays live and your draft is safely kept — a FLUX plan recharges your balance every month so you can publish, generate, and customize.
publish.insufficientText: Publishing a new version costs {cost} credits and you have {balance} left. Your changes are safely saved as a draft — they're waiting for you.
publish.plansHint: FLUX plans recharge from 100 to 3000 credits per month: more credits means more possibilities for your site.
publish.confirmText: Your changes will go live, visible to your customers. Each publish uses our servers: it costs {cost} credits.
publish.toastEmailUnverified: Verify your email address to publish. The link is waiting in your inbox.
publish.toastNothingToPublish: Nothing to publish: your site is already up to date.
publish.toastContentBlocked: Hate speech or explicit content is forbidden and penalized on FLUX; please respect your environment and that of others. After 3 violations of our terms of use, the account is deleted.
publish.toastGenericError: Unable to publish. Try again in a moment.
publish.toastSuccess: Version {version} published! Your site is up to date. Balance: {balance} cr.
